records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue was up 13% sequentially with growth in all market platforms.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Fueled by the sustained demand for exceptional 3D graphics and the scale of the gaming market, NVIDIA has leveraged its GPU architecture to create platforms for scientific computing, AI, data science, autonomous vehicles, or AV, robotics, and augmented and virtual reality, or AR and VR.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Inventory provisions totaled $58 million and $36 million for the first quarter of fiscal years 2022 and 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was down 100 basis points from a year earlier due to amortization of intangible assets related to the Mellanox acquisition and a shift in the mix of Data Center products, partially offset by a lower contribution from Automotive products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations was $1.96 billion, up 100% from a year earlier and up 30% sequentially.
